title: Nonasymptotic bounds for quantum purity amplification
summary: In quantum purity amplification, one is given $n$ copies of a noisy quantum state $ρ\in \mathbb{C}^{d \times d}$ and asked to prepare $k$ copies of its principal eigenstate $|v_d\rangle$. Several prior works have derived information-theoretically optimal algorithms for this problem, but the bounds they prove are only shown in the asymptotic regime as the number of samples $n$ tends to infinity.
